description: Configure PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication with a synchronous standby for automatic failover. The primary handles ~15,000 TPS on an OLTP workload. The standby must be provisioned in a separate availability zone with identical instance specs (64 vCPU, 512 GB RAM, 6 TB NVMe SSD). Replication slots must be managed to prevent WAL accumulation. Patroni or repmgr must be configured for automated failover detection and promotion. Verify replication lag stays under 100ms at P99. Tools available: Patroni, repmgr, pg_stat_replication pgviews, Ansible playbooks, Terraform for infrastructure.
